item.title: Lowell bids out almost $5M for street, sidewalk repairs
item.description: LOWELL — In news that will spare the undercarriages and rims of vehicles and the peace of mind and safety of pedestrians, Lowell’s Department of Public Works bid out an almost $5 million in two contracts for reconstruction of the streets and sidewalks on three major thoroughfares and several surface streets in the city.

item.title: Derrick White (28 points), Celtics romp past host Rockets
item.description: HOUSTON (AP) — Derrick White made six 3-pointers and scored 28 points and the Boston Celtics used a big third quarter to build the lead and cruise to a 114-93 win over the Houston Rockets on Wednesday night. White’s performance helped the Celtics win a fourth straight game despite missing star Jaylen Brown, who sat out with left hamstring tightness in the second game of a back-to-back.
